EPISODE LOGLINE: Priya returns as the owner of the company where Rohan works.

SCENE 1

**ACTION:** [0.0s - 2.5s]
Rohan waits nervously outside the chairman's office.

**ROHAN (Confident):** [2.8s - 6.3s]
"Today I get the promotion. Neha, book the restaurant."

**ACTION:** [6.6s - 9.6s]
The door opens. Priya sits behind the desk in a black sari.

**ROHAN (Shocked):** [9.9s - 12.9s]
"Priya? What are you doing in the chairman's chair?"

**PRIYA (Calm):** [13.2s - 16.7s]
"Sit down, Mr. Rohan. Your file is on my desk."

**ROHAN (Angry):** [17.0s - 20.0s]
"This is some joke. Where is the real chairman?"

**PRIYA (Cold):** [20.3s - 22.3s]
"You are looking at her."

**नेहा (Bursting In):** [22.6s - 26.1s]
"Rohan, there is a problem. The bank called about the flat."

**PRIYA (Smiling):** [26.4s - 29.4s]
"The flat is in my name. It always was."

**सास (Entering, Furious):** [29.7s - 32.7s]
"You witch! You planned all of this!"

**PRIYA (Steady):** [33.0s - 36.0s]
"No, Maa ji. You planned it. I only waited."

**ACTION:** [36.3s - 38.8s]
Priya slides an envelope across the desk to Rohan.

**ROHAN (Afraid):** [39.1s - 41.1s]
"What is this?"

**PRIYA (Quiet):** [41.4s - 44.9s]
"The hospital report. The reason we never had a child."

**ACTION:** [45.2s - 47.7s]
Rohan reads it. The colour leaves his face.

**ROHAN (Whispering):** [48.0s - 51.0s]
"It was me? It was never you?"

**PRIYA (Cold):** [51.3s - 54.3s]
"And your mother knew. For five years."

**ACTION:** [54.6s - 57.6s]
Everyone turns to the mother. She drops her prayer beads. Cut to black.
